FSIN - Full Screen Internet

Run FSIN.exe to open the browser.

Hover Technology:
- Hover in the top-left corner to show Back, Forward, Refresh, and Home.
- Hover near the top-center of the screen to show the search/address bar.
- Type a website or search phrase, then press Enter or Go.

Notes:
- FSIN uses Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome in app/fullscreen mode.
- The controls are injected with the FSIN Hover Technology extension.
- Browser-only pages such as chrome:// or edge:// pages may not allow hover controls.
